summary: Tahap 2 (Modul Piutang/Invoice + Rekap + Pembayaran) end-to-end tested. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed (list default+overdue+paid filters, search no-match, sort amount_desc, create valid + due<invoice_date 400 + total<=0 422 + customer_id invalid 400, partial-then-full payment flow with status auto-transition, overpayment blocked, update total<paid_amount blocked, update ok, receivables/summary shape with aging + top_debtors, viewer read-only 200 on GET/403 on writes, tenant B isolation, cross-tenant 404, audit trail invoice_created/invoice_updated/payment_recorded with old/new). Frontend: all requested flows work end-to-end — /piutang loads with summary cards (Total Piutang Berjalan Rp 18.650.000, Terlambat Rp 6.500.000/2 invoice, Total Terbayar Rp 8.834.567) + aging panel + full table with all required columns + status badges (Lunas/Sebagian/Belum Bayar/Terlambat). Add invoice validates empty customer/zero total, generates INV-XXXXXX sequentially (INV-000014 next), edit shows customer readonly and blocks total<paid_amount with Indonesian error, payment dialog rejects overpayment inline and updates status partial→paid, pay button disappears after paid, detail dialog shows code/customer/totals/history. Dashboard shows dashboard-total-piutang live (Rp 18.650.000) + goto-piutang link. Security page shows Piutang Dibuat/Diperbarui/Pembayaran Dicatat audit entries. RBAC UI: viewer sees list+detail (10 detail buttons) with 0 edit/pay buttons and no Tambah button. Multi-tenant: ownerb only sees INV-000001 (Rp 9.900.000 overdue), summary reflects tenant B only. Mobile 390px: invoice-cards visible, invoice-table hidden. Empty state shows for no-match search. No regressions on Tahap 1A/1B.
critical_code_review_comments: InvoicesPage.jsx is ~580 lines with 3 sub-dialogs (Form/Payment/Detail) inline. Recommend extracting to /components/invoices/* before Tahap 3 to keep review-ability.
server.py continues to grow. Split into routers/ (auth, users, customers, invoices, receivables, security) + shared deps/models — becomes urgent as more modules land.

compute_invoice_status is recomputed on every list read (per-item Python loop). Acceptable at MVP scale but consider storing overdue as a derived indexed field or caching for larger tenants (>1k invoices).
Payment endpoint POST /invoices/{id}/payments correctly rejects overpayment (400) and paid status writes (backend test confirms). Also correctly persists status transition — verified UI-side.

Frontend PaymentDialog defaults amount to invoice.remaining but does not re-fetch remaining before submit — if two staff open concurrently they could both submit; backend guards against overpayment so it degrades gracefully.
Aging bucket labels (current/1-30/31-60/61-90/over_90) are hardcoded — safe for MVP; if reporting rules change, extract to a config.
Dashboard total piutang initially renders '...' placeholder until summary loads (~1-2s). Consider a skeleton for consistency with rest of app.
